_mode_doc: Each iteration must surface a NEW relation (not in known_invariants). Hypothesis-test mode is the fallback when discovery yields no candidates. Loop terminates when residuals can't be reduced further.
headline_definition: |Fz_t (smoothed 0.5s)| < 2 N AND dz/dt < -2 mm/s sustained 0.5 s post-contact
_secondary_doc: Time post-contact at which the FAIL-class median feature trajectory first leaves the GOLD-class [p25, p75] band. Higher = better algorithm (lasted longer before diverging). Currently 0.00s (fz_t) — algorithm diverges immediately.

best_known.note: Baseline across 60 GOLD operator demos + 132 May-04 u_orange autonomous attempts. GOLD subset rate = 0.83; autonomous u_orange subset rate = 0.20.

current_target.note: Use SEAT xy as hole_xy_prior. Source: insert_u_orange_20260504_145614.csv operator-assisted seat point.

FAIL_aligned_negatives.purpose: Trajectories cropped to [-1s, +6s] around contact serve as 132 negative-class probes of state-action space (~40k samples at 100Hz).

transcript_history_v82_v97.purpose: Labeled hypothesis→outcome pairs from prior session — saves re-running refuted hypotheses.

known_invariants.claim: Fz_t collapse from ~9N to <2N marks slot entry across all 4 FMB1 objects
Post-collapse dz/dt = -6.4 mm/s (constant, geometry-independent, with cmd_fz=-9N)
known_invariants.evidence: FINDINGS.md §1; iterations/discovery/002-line-green-geometric-floor confirms line_green truncates at 7.3mm geometric floor not premature seat

known_invariants.claim: Operator search-phase TCP motion direction = (seat_xy - contact_xy).normalized within 5-15°
Operator TCP displacement = 1.2-1.7 mm over ~1s during search phase
Operator F_lat reaction = 2.0-2.9 N (sensor reads opposite of motion direction by Newton's 3rd law)
Search-phase path/bbox ratio: GOLD u_orange ≈ 2.8 (wide arc), FAIL u_orange ≈ 5.4 (tight spiral). u_orange-specific.
known_invariants.portability: verified_u_orange_only_REFUTED_other_objects (GOLD u_brown 6.26 / inv_u_yellow 5.98 / line_green 4.82 overlap FAIL u_orange 5.38)

known_invariants.claim: FAIL F_lat_base diverges from GOLD band at t=+50ms post-contact (0.65N vs band [0.66, 1.57])
FAIL has lower tilt than GOLD at t=+1.6s (0.90° vs 1.56°). Tilt is a POSITIVE progress sign within 5° envelope.

When per-attempt physical-contact-aligned, AUTO_fail u_orange median |Fz_at_contact| (6.11N) > AUTO_success (5.86N) > GOLD (5.45N). The AUTO_success/AUTO_fail gap is only 0.25N (4%) — I009 is real-but-weak, NOT a primary discriminator. (Original I009 used a script-07 alignment that overstated the gap as 1.20N / 20%.)
known_invariants.portability: u_orange_only — cross-object FAIL data unavailable, flagged needs_robot_data

known_invariants.claim: line_green seat depth is a geometric constant: 7.3 ± 0.4 mm (n=18 GOLD, IQR=0.35mm), vs ~31mm for the other 3 FMB1 objects. Universal seat predicates must use per-object or fraction-of-expected depth, not a hardcoded ≥25mm threshold.
known_invariants.portability: object-specific (line_green); finding-pattern generalizes (every object has a CAD-determined seat depth)

known_invariants.claim: GOLD-class first-contact median |Fz_t| (smoothed ±50ms) is 4.5–5.6 N across all 4 FMB1 objects (u_orange 5.45 / u_brown 5.47 / inv_u_yellow 5.58 / line_green 4.50), with within-object IQR ≤ 2.0 N. Universal approach-velocity target: first-contact lands in [4.5, 6.5] N — single cmd_fz works for all 4 objects.

On 119 u_orange AUTO attempts (19 success / 100 fail, per-attempt physical-contact aligned, ±50ms smoothed), no per-timepoint median trajectory in {fz_t, F_lat_base, F_lat_tool, dz_dt, tilt, z_drop, xy_excursion, r_cop} has its AUTO_fail p50 leave the AUTO_success [p25,p75] band for any sustained 100ms window in [0, +4s] post-contact. The post-contact median band is NOT a discriminator. Three features (tilt, F_lat_base early, xy_excursion late) show consistent-direction sub-band lifts but never sustained band-leaving. The success/fail signal must lie either at contact (initial xy alignment) or in feature aggregates beyond per-timepoint medians.
known_invariants.portability: u_orange_only — needs cross-object verification flagged needs_robot_data

pending_hypotheses_discovery.rationale: I006: failure is winding spiral, forced translation breaks loop

Soft ramp closes that 0.4N gap — modest hygiene improvement, not a discriminator. Keep as always-on softening, not a fix-the-failure-mode patch.

pending_hypotheses_discovery.summary: Train logistic regression on aligned post-contact windows (positive=GOLD, negative=FAIL) at t=+50ms; predict success probability before search even completes
pending_hypotheses_discovery.rationale: I007: F_lat_base diverges at t=+50ms — fast-fail signal possible

pending_hypotheses_discovery.summary: Cross-check FSM-claimed events vs CSV ground truth using raw_fsm_logs/. For each attempt: parse FSM stdout for 'engagement_confirmed' / 'STUCK' / 'GLOBAL SEAT' / 'abort' events with timestamps, compare to physics-derived events (Fz collapse / z_drop / dz_dt) at the same wall-clock time. Disagreements identify FSM detection bugs.
pending_hypotheses_discovery.predicted_delta: categorize FSM detection bugs by frequency; rank-order which gate is most often wrong
pending_hypotheses_discovery.rationale: User insight: FSM detection logic was guessed thresholds, not physics. The same logic that produced stagnant iterations is also generating its own stdout claims. Treat FSM logs as a HYPOTHESIS to falsify, not a label.

pending_hypotheses_discovery.summary: Build (csv, fsm_config) pairing table: parse loop_attempt_NNN.log for startup config (spiral_F_max, find_hole_fz, engaged_tilt_max_deg, hole_xy_prior), pair with the CSV produced. Label is the OBSERVED outcome from CSV (final_z_drop_mm ≥ 20mm), NOT the FSM-claimed outcome.
pending_hypotheses_discovery.predicted_delta: 132 May-4 failures gain config labels → can run config-vs-outcome regression
pending_hypotheses_discovery.rationale: FSM CONFIG (startup parameters) IS reliable; FSM DETECTION (runtime claims) is not. Separate the two.

trust_hierarchy._doc: What can be trusted as ground truth, in descending order. Discovery loop must respect this.
1_fully_trusted: raw CSV columns (TCP pose, sensed wrench, gripper, commanded_fz, target pose)
loop_attempt_NNN.log STARTUP config block (FSM parameters at run start)
2_derived_trusted: Fz collapse, dz/dt, xy excursion, tilt — all computed FROM raw CSV columns by analysis scripts
physics-derived phase boundaries (contact / engagement / seated) per scripts/01_extract.py
3_NEVER_trust: FSM-reported outcome (success/abort/timeout) — was based on guessed predicates
any signals.json field other than the raw thresholds (segmentation methods M1-M5 used baselines that are themselves derived from prior data — circular if treated as labels)
trust_hierarchy.rationale: The 16-iteration v82-v97 stagnation was caused by FSM detection thresholds being wrong. Its stdout claims and outcome flags reflect the same wrong thresholds. Re-using them as labels recreates the original bug.

open_questions: When no prior demo exists, where does seat_xy come from? CAD has 5-17mm error — needs an estimator.
Is the c→s direction from CAD reliable enough as a SEED prior, or should the algorithm tumble through 6 directions before settling?

Where post-contact does AUTO_success diverge from AUTO_fail u_orange? Discovery 003 showed contact-Fz is NOT the discriminator (only 0.25N gap, 4% relative). Recompute script 07's per-feature divergence using per-attempt physical-contact alignment (not script 07's t=0 windowing) to find the true earliest-divergence feature.

These specific questions need schema bump for FUTURE answers (see G001-G004), but the discovery loop has plenty of unblocked work on the existing 60 GOLD + 132 AUTO data. Apply schema fix only when next data collection happens anyway — do NOT re-collect existing demos.

[needs_robot_data] Cross-object verification of the AUTO_fail vs GOLD contact-Fz pattern (I009 refined): only u_orange has FAIL data. Need 30+ AUTO attempts on u_brown / line_green / inv_u_yellow to test whether the ~0.7N AUTO-vs-GOLD lift is portable.

data_recording_gaps.name: joint_states never subscribed
data_recording_gaps.impact: Cannot reconstruct TCP via FK as cross-check. Cannot detect joint-near-singularity moments. Cannot recover commanded joint trajectory the controller produced from the force-mode wrench. Cannot diagnose rotation-axis bias in operator nudges (e.g. wrist twist vs base twist).
data_recording_gaps.fix: Add `self.create_subscription(JointState, '/joint_states', self._joint_cb, sensor_qos)` to wrapper. Stream to a sidecar `<basename>.joints_raw.csv` at native rate (~125 Hz UR native), one row per message, with native header.stamp.

data_recording_gaps.name: Per-sample 6-axis cmd not logged
data_recording_gaps.impact: May-4 v82-v97 attempts had FSM-driven dynamic cmd_fx/fy/tx/ty/tz; only cmd_fz logged. Failures are uninterpretable at the lateral-command level. May-3 GOLD is fine (cmd was static, in meta).
data_recording_gaps.fix: Schema v1.2 bump: add `cmd_fx, cmd_fy, cmd_tx, cmd_ty, cmd_tz` columns. Track all 6 on `self` in `_call_set_force_mode`. ~5 floats × 100 Hz = ~80 KB/s extra. Trivial.

data_recording_gaps.name: Wrench downsampled 5x with no native-rate archive
data_recording_gaps.impact: Native 500 Hz wrench → 100 Hz CSV drops 80% of samples. Sub-10ms transients (peg-rim impact spikes, controller bandwidth artifacts) aliased. Brief contact events that may be diagnostic of approach-velocity (G004 hypothesis I009) are smoothed out.
data_recording_gaps.fix: Sidecar `<basename>.wrench_raw.csv` written from the wrench callback at native rate. ~24 bytes × 500 Hz = 12 KB/s. Keep the 100 Hz CSV for dashboard simplicity; raw is for forensics.

data_recording_gaps.name: force_mode_controller state not subscribed
data_recording_gaps.impact: Controller's view of 'what wrench did I actually apply this tick' (vs. what was commanded) is invisible. Cannot diagnose controller saturation, gain/damping mismatch, or velocity-limit clipping.
data_recording_gaps.fix: Subscribe to `/force_mode_controller/state` (or whichever status topic the controller publishes). Sidecar CSV at native rate.

data_recording_gaps.name: Native per-topic timestamps replaced by single 100Hz timer clock
data_recording_gaps.impact: Time alignment between wrench and pose is fixed at the 100 Hz timer cadence (10 ms granularity). Real wrench-to-pose lag (controller delay) cannot be measured from CSV.
data_recording_gaps.fix: Adding G001-G004 sidecars implicitly fixes this — each sidecar uses native header.stamp.

blockers_active.name: URCap external control stops after >170s force-mode runs
Operator pendant manual PLAY required after each abort

Schema-bump-v1.2 should be applied BEFORE the NEXT collection session — but existing 60 GOLD demos do NOT need re-collection. The current data supports operator-nudge behavioral cloning, all 9 invariants, cross-object portability tests, and many discovery iterations. Re-collect only when collecting new objects or validating a successful FSM change.

convergence_criteria._doc: Two-phase. Phase A is the ralph loop's job (away-from-robot). Phase B is the operator's at-robot validation. Loop stops at Phase A; operator runs Phase B in one robot session.

phase_A_away_from_robot.completion_promise: <promise>RALPH_CONVERGED</promise> written into a final discovery iteration's RESULTS.md when all sub-criteria below are met
criteria_all_required: open_questions empty (or remaining items tagged needs_robot_data)
all pending_hypotheses_discovery entries either staged or marked unstageable with reason
known_invariants cover >=3 of (u_orange, u_brown, line_green, inv_u_yellow)

phase_B_at_robot.trigger: operator runs `bash analysis/scripts/ralph.sh apply <staged_name>` with the top-ranked staged patch
phase_B_at_robot.primary: durable_collapse_rate >= 0.80 on a fresh 5-attempt batch for the active object
phase_B_at_robot.model_completeness: every failure in fresh batch maps to a known invariant or v82_v97_iteration_history failure mode
phase_B_at_robot.outcome_pass: promote staged/<name> -> validated/<name>, commit FSM change
phase_B_at_robot.outcome_fail: revert wrapper/configs, append to tried_and_refuted with ROBOT_REFUTED tag, fresh CSVs feed Phase A again
